effects: Sets the ratified flag for (maker, root) to newIsRootRatified in RateRatifierV1 storage. The signer must be the maker or an address the maker authorized on Midnight.

When the flag is true, every rate offer in the Merkle tree with that root becomes fillable by takers on Midnight at the committed rates, against the maker's positions. When it is false, those offers stop being fillable.
No tokens or native currency move. The function is not payable, and no allowance is set or spent.
formats.shown: "Set order approval of <maker> to Yes/No", with fields for the Maker address, the Merkle root as raw hex, and Ratified Yes/No.

findings.title: setIsRootRatified: the Root is an opaque Merkle hash that stands for offer terms the screen cannot show.
findings.evidence: RateRatifierV1.sol isRatified: require(HashLib.isLeaf(root, HashLib.hashRateRatifierV1Offer(offer, rate, allowedTaker), leafIndex, proof)) and require(ratification[offer.maker][root].isRootRatified). Descriptor field '#.root' 'Root' format raw. Both blind readers list 'What the orders in that root actually are' as unsure.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix exists. The calldata carries only the root, not the offers (markets, ticks, rates, allowed takers) it commits to.

findings.title: setIsRootRatified: the 'order approval' wording does not say that ratifying makes the offers in the tree fillable.
findings.evidence: intent 'Update order approval'; interpolatedIntent 'Set order approval of {#.maker} to {#.newIsRootRatified}'; enum ratificationStatus false:'No', true:'Yes'. In the code, the isRootRatified flag is the gate that lets takers fill any offer in the tree (isRatified).
findings.fix: Optionally use wording such as intent 'Enable or disable rate offers', and enum labels 'Enable offers (fillable by takers)' / 'Disable offers'. The outcome is already implied by the action shown, so this is optional.

cases.notes: The mined tx has no token, ETH or approval effects. The signer is the maker. The screen and the reader agree that this is a status change with no asset movement. The calldata carries 8 extra trailing bytes (6acf5edd12121212) that ABI decoding ignores.
The mined tx has no token, ETH or approval effects. The signer is the maker. The reader correctly understood a ratification flag set to Yes.
